name: Dog vs Werewolf
look: Photo of a smiling golden retriever with its tongue out, sitting on a gray floor beside a life-size werewolf figure on all fours. The werewolf has shaggy gray fur, glowing orange eyes, long claws and a snarling red mouth full of fangs. Antlers poke in at the left edge.
use: The cheerful dog and the snarling werewolf are labeled as two sides of the same thing: how it seems versus how it really is, or how it acts at different times.
slots: the harmless version (the golden retriever, left)
describe: happy golden retriever sitting next to a scary werewolf
